question_text: Describe how a reinforcement-learning agent controlling a delivery robot in a simulated building can improve navigation. Refer to states, actions, rewards, policy, and exploration versus exploitation.
adaptation_rationale: Reframe general adaptation as explicit reinforcement-learning agent/environment reasoning. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: State describes current observations/location; actions choose movement. Environment returns a new state and reward for useful progress or penalties for collisions. Agent updates its policy to improve cumulative reward, trying uncertain actions while also choosing actions currently believed to work well.
